id.description: Unique identifier for the priority alert criterion.

scheduleName.description: Name of the schedule associated with the criteria.

notificationEnabled.description: Determines whether priority alerting is applied for calls matching this criteria. If `true`, priority alerting is applied. If `false`, this criteria acts as a 'Don't Alert' rule, preventing priority alerting. Criteria with `notificationEnabled` set to `false` (Don't Alert) take precedence over criteria with `notificationEnabled` set to `true` (Alert).

source.description:
Type of the source.
 * `ALL_NUMBERS` - User wants to be notified for calls from Any Phone Number.
 * `SPECIFIC_NUMBERS` - User wants to be notified for calls from Select Phone Numbers.
